items.claim: The fighter has repeatedly been taken down and nearly finished by opponents in past bouts.
items.quote: We've seen this guy taken down in the past. We saw Ewan Cout Lava take him down a bunch. Nearly finish him in that first round.

items.claim: Yonhovich has the ability to secure takedowns against the fence and establish top position.
items.quote: I think if Yonhovich wants to, he can get him to the fence. He could shoot for that single leg and he can get in top position.

items.claim: Yonhovich has faced an elite strength of schedule over the last couple of years, fighting top champions and contenders.
items.quote: And you look at the guys that Yonhovich has fought over the last couple of years. He's fighting champions.
